decision: Acquire only the common exact-mark segment. Do not acquire or replay the earlier oracle-only interval as if it contained liquidation-risk truth.

first_hour.interpretation: Exact marks exist, but interval completeness remains a lifecycle-level property and must not be inferred from non-null coverage alone.

resource_estimate.basis: Trade density and compression from the exact Aug12-Aug13 paired window; price density and compression from local MU bundles.
limitations: Session activity can materially change trade page counts.
Rate limits and retries can dominate wall time.
Non-null marks do not establish continuous mark paths; every selected lifecycle must retain gap-aware path evidence.

post_acquisition_acceptance: Every expected book, trade, and price hour has a complete source-matched manifest or an explicitly reconciled empty range.
Every evidence file rehashes to its manifest.
Raw and canonical trade counts reconcile with duplicate conflicts reported explicitly.
Price coverage reports null marks, empty hours, boundary gaps, maximum intervals, and exact mark-only bounds.
A common chronological split is frozen before any candidate family is evaluated.
Development selects once; validation advances once; untouched holdout changes only final evaluation.
L2 is used for executable quotes, public-trade OHLC for signals, and exact marks for risk; no silent source substitution.
Realistic fees, funding, spread, latency, delay, stop-path, session, side, and largest-winner sensitivity are reported.
failure_modes: Any checksum or identity mismatch aborts acquisition reuse.
Any conflicting duplicate trade aborts canonicalization until reconciled.
Any selected development lifecycle crossing unresolved mark or L2 evidence aborts qualification without selecting a replacement.
Validation or holdout cannot influence candidate identity or parameter selection.
Acquisition completion alone grants no live, strategy, asset, or promotion authority.

confidence.level: high on exact common source boundary and resumable acquisition; medium on projected size and runtime; low on economic edge until chronological testing
confidence.falsifier: A missing/nullable mark inside the declared source scope, unreconciled bundle, materially higher page rate, conflicting trade identity, or unresolved selected path updates or aborts the study.

single_highest_value_next_investigation: Complete and checksum-audit the common exact-mark trade/price continuation, then evaluate one distinct non-crypto family without touching v53.
